_source: Fonts offered for CEWE books: macOS system fonts on CEWE's printable list (fonts-mac.xml). adv/boldAdv = advance width per character in 1/1000 em (regular/bold); avg = average over a German sample; lineSpacing = the font's natural line pitch in em (hhea ascent + descent + gap), which CEWE's line-height percentage is relative to. Generated by tools/cewe_font_metrics.mjs. Only measured numeric metrics are stored here, never the font files themselves - see README.md's Acknowledgments section for why that's believed low-risk.
